Home.title: Capri Private Boat Experience
Home.subtitle: Discover hidden grottos, swim in clear blue water, and enjoy Capri from the sea with a local captain.
Home.videoNote: Your Capri video will sit here
Home.heroCardText: Flexible private trips for couples, families, and small groups.
Home.whyTitle: Simple, personal, and built around your pace
Home.whySubtitle: This is not a crowded group tour. It is a private Capri experience with time to swim, take photos, and enjoy the island.
Home.whyLocalText: Your captain knows the best timing, swimming spots, and sea conditions around Capri.
Home.whyPrivateText: Choose a relaxed route, more swim time, or a scenic cruise for photos and views. Play your own music and enjoy the scenic points without rushing.
Home.whyEasyText: Connect directly with the boat owner, with no platform or agency charges, no forced tips, no extra fuel charges, and simple amenities included free.
Home.includedSubtitle: Simple, transparent extras are already included, so you can relax once you step on board.
Home.includedSoftDrinksText: Water, Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite, and lemon soda are included for every tour.
Home.includedWineText: Alcoholic drinks include wine and champagne, included as part of the private boat experience.
Home.includedTowelsText: Towels are provided on board, so you can swim and dry off comfortably.
Home.includedFuelText: Fuel is included in the tour price. There are no extra fuel charges.
Home.includedSnorkelingText: Snorkeling equipment is available on board when sea conditions are suitable.
Home.highlightOneText: Stop in beautiful coves and swim from the boat when conditions allow.
Home.highlightTwoText: See cliffs, sea caves, Faraglioni views, and the island's most photogenic coastline.
Home.highlightThreeText: No rush, no crowds, just a premium private day shaped around your group.
Home.routeSubtitle: An interactive view of Capri’s coastline and the places the captain may include as conditions and tour duration allow.

Home.stepOneText: Tell us your date, group size, email, phone number, and preferred tour style.
Home.stepTwoText: We check the schedule and reply with details, timing, and meeting point.
Home.stepThreeText: Meet your captain, step aboard, and enjoy a memorable private boat experience.
Home.faqOneQuestion: Is this a confirmed booking after I submit the form?
Home.faqOneAnswer: Not yet. The form sends a request. We confirm availability and details with you first.
Home.faqTwoAnswer: Yes. Private tours can be adjusted based on weather, sea conditions, and your preferences.
Home.faqThreeQuestion: What happens if the weather is bad?
Home.faqThreeAnswer: Safety comes first. If conditions are not suitable, we will discuss another time or date.
Home.faqFourAnswer: The Blue Grotto is optional and not guaranteed. It depends on sea conditions, opening status, queue time, and tour duration.
Home.finalTitle: Ready to see Capri from the sea?
Home.finalText: Send a quick request and we will help you plan the right private boat experience.

Faq.title: Questions before you book
Faq.subtitle: Clear answers about booking, payments, weather, route details, Blue Grotto, and what to expect on board.
Faq.searchPlaceholder: Search by topic, for example Blue Grotto, payment, weather...
Faq.noResults: No matching questions found. Try a different keyword or contact us with your question.
Faq.bookingConfirmationQuestion: Is my booking confirmed after I submit the request form?
Faq.bookingConfirmationAnswer: Not yet. The form sends a booking request. We check availability with the captain first, then reply with the next steps. Your time slot is only locked after captain confirmation and reservation fee payment.
Faq.blueGrottoQuestion: Is the Blue Grotto included or guaranteed?
Faq.blueGrottoAnswer: Blue Grotto is optional and not guaranteed. It depends on sea conditions, opening status, queue time, and tour duration. The entrance fee is not included in the boat tour price. It is currently €18 per person and is paid directly at the cave by cash or card if you choose to enter. The wait is often around 40 minutes to 1 hour, especially in June, July, and August.
Faq.tourIncludedQuestion: What is included in the private boat tour?
Faq.tourIncludedAnswer: All tours include the private boat experience with the captain, the selected tour duration, soft drinks (water, Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite, and lemon soda), wine, champagne, towels, fuel, and snorkeling equipment. Blue Grotto entrance and other third-party costs are not included unless we explicitly confirm otherwise.
Faq.weatherQuestion: What happens if weather or sea conditions are not safe?
Faq.weatherAnswer: The captain makes the final safety decision. If the tour cannot run safely because of weather or sea conditions, we will help you reschedule when possible or arrange the reservation fee refund according to the policy.
Faq.reservationFeeQuestion: Why do I need to pay a reservation fee?
Faq.reservationFeeAnswer: The reservation fee secures the boat and locks your time slot after the captain confirms availability. If the fee is not paid within 24 hours after captain confirmation, the request may be released.
Faq.remainingBalanceQuestion: How do I pay the remaining balance?
Faq.remainingBalanceAnswer: The remaining balance is paid on board directly to the captain on the day of the tour. Cash is preferred, but card payment is also available.
Faq.cancellationQuestion: Can I cancel after the booking is confirmed?
Faq.cancellationAnswer: If your booking is confirmed and you need to cancel, please contact us as soon as possible. Cancellation terms depend on timing and the reason for cancellation.
Faq.lateArrivalQuestion: What happens if we arrive late?
Faq.lateArrivalAnswer: Please arrive on time. Late arrival may reduce the tour duration because the boat schedule and captain availability are planned around confirmed time slots.
Faq.routeQuestion: Is the route always the same?
Faq.routeAnswer: No. The route may vary depending on tour duration, weather, sea conditions, queue times, and the captain’s judgment. The map shows possible highlights, not a guaranteed fixed route.
Faq.swimmingQuestion: Can we swim during the tour?
Faq.swimmingAnswer: Usually yes when the weather and sea conditions are suitable. The captain will suggest safe and beautiful swim stops based on the day’s conditions.
Faq.meetingPointQuestion: Where do we meet the captain?
Faq.meetingPointAnswer: We confirm the exact meeting point after availability is checked and the booking is moving forward. The details will be shared before your tour.
Faq.whatToBringQuestion: What should we bring on board?
Faq.whatToBringAnswer: Bring swimwear, sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, a towel, and anything personal you need for a few hours at sea. A light layer can be useful if it is windy.
Faq.stillHaveQuestionsText: Send a booking request with your preferred date and notes. We can answer specific questions before anything is confirmed.

Policy.title: Clear terms before you reserve
Policy.subtitle: We keep the process simple: request a booking, confirm availability, pay the reservation fee, then enjoy your day at sea.
Policy.introText: These notes explain the main booking terms in plain language. If anything is unclear, contact us before paying the reservation fee.
Policy.reservationFeeText: The reservation fee secures the boat for your confirmed date and departure time.
Policy.paymentWindowText: Once the captain confirms your selected time, you have 24 hours to pay the reservation fee. If the fee is not paid within that time, the request may be released.
Policy.balanceText: The remaining balance is paid on board directly to the captain on the day of the tour. Cash is preferred, but card payment is also available.
Policy.weatherText: Weather, sea conditions, and safety decisions are made by the captain. Safety always comes first.
Policy.weatherCancellationText: If the captain cancels for weather or sea safety, we will help you reschedule. If rescheduling is not possible, the reservation fee can be refunded.
Policy.lateArrivalText: Please arrive on time. Late arrival may reduce the tour duration because the boat schedule is reserved for a fixed time.
Policy.noShowText: If guests do not arrive and do not contact us, the reservation fee is non-refundable.
Policy.confirmedCancellationText: If your booking is confirmed and you need to cancel, please contact us directly so we can review the situation and next steps.
Policy.blueGrottoText: The Blue Grotto is optional and not guaranteed. It depends on sea conditions, opening status, queue time, and tour duration. Blue Grotto entrance fee is not included. It is currently €18 per person. If Blue Grotto is open and you choose to enter, the entrance fee is paid directly at the cave by cash or card. The wait is often around 40 minutes to 1 hour, especially in June, July, and August. It is usually not recommended for 2-hour or 3-hour tours, is more suitable for 4-hour, 5-hour, or full-day tours, and is not recommended for the sunset tour.
Policy.contactText: If you have questions about your booking or these terms, visit the contact page before your tour date.
